name: Ory
tagline: Open source identity infrastructure. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, MFA, permissions.
shortDescription: Ory is an open source identity infrastructure. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, WebAuthn, MFA, permissions API, and a control plane for managing identities. The CNCF identity stack.
longDescription:
## What it is

Ory is a suite of open source identity services: Ory Hydra (OAuth2/OIDC), Ory Kratos (identity/user management), Ory Oathkeeper (identity proxy), Ory Keto (permissions), and Ory Fosite (OAuth2 library). All CNCF projects, all production-grade.

## Why we recommend it

If you need OAuth2/OIDC/SAML/MFA and don't want to pay Auth0/Okta fees, Ory is the answer. Each component can be used standalone or composed. The license is Apache-2.0, and the cloud offering is reasonably priced.

## When to use it

- OAuth2/OIDC provider for your app
- Replacing Auth0/Okta with self-hosting
- Multi-tenant SaaS with per-tenant identity
- When you need SAML for enterprise SSO
installInstructions:
**Each component is a Go binary. Docker images are also available.**

**Ory Hydra (OAuth2/OIDC):**
```
docker run -d --name hydra -p 4444:4444 -p 4445:4445 oryd/hydra:latest serve all --dangerous-force-http
```

**Cloud:** Ory Network - free tier, $25/month production.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Ory Network: free tier. $25/month for production. Enterprise: custom.
